name: Effective Range / Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: Every coordinate trace has effective range at most that of the original class.
proof: For every S, $\mathrm{RTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S})\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H_{|S})\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$. Maximize the left-hand side over S.
